title: Fix order ban pre-check to use caller-safe ban status and unblock non-banned ordering

requirements.summary: Update the New Order creation flow to use a caller-safe ban check (and graceful fallback) so non-banned authenticated users can place orders, while banned users see a clear error.
acceptanceCriteria: From a signed-in (Internet Identity) account that is not banned, submitting the New Order form successfully creates an order and shows the success confirmation UI.
If the UI performs a ban check before order creation, that ban check does not fail due to missing backend method or authorization errors.
If the caller is banned, order creation is blocked and the user sees a clear English error message indicating they are banned.

file_operations.description: Replace the current pre-check that calls isUserBanned(principal) (which can fail for non-admins) with the backend-provided caller-safe ban check (isCallerBanned()). Ensure the mutation blocks immediately with a clear English message when banned, and if the ban pre-check unexpectedly errors (network/actor issues), it logs and proceeds to attempt order creation (server-side enforcement still applies). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden UI error handling for order submission so ban-related failures surface as a clear, user-friendly banned message (including cases where the backend rejects order creation). Keep existing success redirect behavior to /dashboard?orderCreated=true for successful creates. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
